test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: There are 4 pipes attached to a tank. Two to fill the tank and the other two to transfer the water into a cistern. The first two pipes can fill the tank in 40 sec and 80 sec, respectively, when opened alone, while the last two can empty in 80 sec and 160 sec, respectively, when opened alone. If all the pipes are opened together, in how much time will the tank be filled?
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe 1 fills the tank in 40 sec

Pipe 2 fills the tank in 80 sec

Pipe 3 empties the tank in 80 sec

Pipe 4 empties the tank in 160 sec

**Formula used:**

Net rate of filling = (Rate of filling by Pipe 1 + Rate of filling by Pipe 2) - (Rate of emptying by Pipe 3 + Rate of emptying by Pipe 4)

**Calculation:**

Rate of filling by Pipe 1 = (1)/(40) tank/sec

Rate of filling by Pipe 2 = (1)/(80) tank/sec

Rate of emptying by Pipe 3 = (1)/(80) tank/sec

Rate of emptying by Pipe 4 = (1)/(160) tank/sec

⇒ Net rate of filling = (1)/(40) + (1)/(80) - (1)/(80) - (1)/(160)

⇒ Net rate of filling = (1)/(40) - (1)/(160)

⇒ Net rate of filling = (4 - 1)/(160)

⇒ Net rate of filling = (3)/(160) tank/sec

Time to fill the tank = (1)/(frac{3){160}} sec

⇒ Time to fill the tank = (160)/(3) sec

⇒ Time to fill the tank = 53.33 sec

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
